armory.oathbound.arcanist_robe.name: Arcanist Regalia
armory.oathbound.arcanist_robe.note: Light, but not armour for a knight.
armory.oathbound.arcanist_robe.text: Robes of the Spire, sewn from spellsilk. The full regalia halves the cooldowns of the Order's arts and lets you drift gently when you sneak mid-air.
armory.oathbound.dawnbreaker.name: Dawnbreaker
armory.oathbound.dawnbreaker.text: The blade that ended the Hollow King. Hold it high to gather light, then let it go in a *Dawn Rite* that strikes the Gloam and the undead threefold.
armory.oathbound.dawnstring_longbow.name: Dawnstring Longbow
armory.oathbound.dawnstring_longbow.note: Sunmarked foes glow and take 30% more damage.
armory.oathbound.dawnstring_longbow.text: A bow strung with spellsilk and light. A full draw looses a sun-arrow that pierces and *Sunmarks* what it strikes.
armory.oathbound.drowned_anchor.name: The Drowned Anchor
armory.oathbound.drowned_anchor.text: Sir Caldris's anchor. Thrown on its chain it hooks a creature and hauls it to you, or bites into stone and hauls you after it.
armory.oathbound.everflame_lantern.name: The Everflame Lantern
armory.oathbound.everflame_lantern.note: Some oaths are worth keeping after all.
armory.oathbound.everflame_lantern.text: The Order's own lantern, rekindled with an ember of the first dawn and the insignia of its fallen knights. It never gutters.
armory.oathbound.hollow_crown.name: The Hollow Crown
armory.oathbound.hollow_crown.note: You never swore on it. That is why it is safe.
armory.oathbound.hollow_crown.text: Morvane's crown, empty now. It grants sight in the dark, a little more life, and the Gloam's creatures will not trouble its wearer unless provoked.
armory.oathbound.housecarl_warhorn.name: Housecarl's Warhorn
armory.oathbound.housecarl_warhorn.note: They will not strike you, whatever you do.
armory.oathbound.housecarl_warhorn.text: Hrodgar's horn. Sounded, it calls two Spectral Housecarls to fight beside you for forty seconds.
armory.oathbound.lumen_flask.name: Lumen Flask
armory.oathbound.lumen_flask.note: Three from one measure of luminous dust.
armory.oathbound.lumen_flask.text: A glass of light. Thrown, it bursts, blinding and burning Gloam creatures and leaving wisplights hanging in the air.
armory.oathbound.oathkey.name: The Oathkey
armory.oathbound.oathkey.note: Set it in the Sundered Keystone.
armory.oathbound.oathkey.text: The three seals bound into one key. It opens the Sundered Gate, and nothing else.
armory.oathbound.oathsteel_longsword.not: Oathsteel mends itself slowly in the sun.
armory.oathbound.oathsteel_longsword.tex: A patient blade. Every wound you take in the three seconds before you swing is added to the blow as a *Riposte*.
armory.oathbound.shadowreap_sickle.name: Shadowreap Sickle
armory.oathbound.shadowreap_sickle.note: In daylight it is only a sickle.
armory.oathbound.shadowreap_sickle.text: A sickle that drinks the dark. The less light around what it strikes, the harder the blow and the more of it returns to you as health.
armory.oathbound.staff_of_veyl.name: Staff of Veyl
armory.oathbound.staff_of_veyl.text: The Archmage's staff. It looses an *Arcane Chain* that leaps from foe to foe, up to five, weakening with every leap.
armory.oathbound.wardens_halberd.name: Warden's Halberd
armory.oathbound.wardens_halberd.note: Oathsteel mends itself slowly in the sun.
armory.oathbound.wardens_halberd.text: A long reach, and a sprinting strike that drives through every foe in a line.
armory.oathbound.wardens_lantern.name: Warden's Lantern
armory.oathbound.wardens_lantern.note: Feed it lumenite shards when it runs low.
armory.oathbound.wardens_lantern.text: The lantern every knight of the Order carried. Held, it keeps a wisplight burning at your head, wakes Hymn Stones and relights Ward Lanterns. Used, it *Seeks* the next place the Chronicle would send you.
bestiary.oathbound.animated_tome.name: Animated Tome
bestiary.oathbound.animated_tome.text: Grimoires of the Arcanist's Spire that learned to fly after their readers stopped reading. They flit erratically and loose glyph bolts.
bestiary.oathbound.archmage_veyl.name: Archmage Veyl
bestiary.oathbound.archmage_veyl.note: His orbs can be struck back at him. Of his reflections, only the real one's staff burns gold.
bestiary.oathbound.archmage_veyl.text: The Order's master of wards, who bound his own mind into the Seal of Wisdom. He blinks, he mirrors himself, and his gravity glyphs lift the ground from under you.
bestiary.oathbound.ashen_revenant.name: Ashen Revenant
bestiary.oathbound.ashen_revenant.note: Fight it in the rain. Leaves *coal*, *gold* and, sometimes, an *ember core*.
bestiary.oathbound.ashen_revenant.text: A knight burned in the Sundering who never stopped burning. It walks the dry lands at night trailing sparks; its blade sets what it cuts alight, and water makes it hiss and falter.
bestiary.oathbound.barrow_wight.name: Barrow Wight
bestiary.oathbound.barrow_wight.note: Their Grave Chill slows you and dulls your pick.
bestiary.oathbound.barrow_wight.text: Grave-spirits of the Barrow of Kings, drifting in the burial cloth they were laid out in. Their touch carries the cold of the tomb.
bestiary.oathbound.bog_mother.name: The Bog Mother
bestiary.oathbound.bog_mother.note: Kill the brood first. Break line of sight from her volleys. Leaves her *lantern* and *hag's eyes*.
bestiary.oathbound.bog_mother.text: The first and oldest of the mire hags, grown vast in her stilt-house over the black water. She fights at a distance with witch-fire and sucking bog, steps away through her own lanterns when a blade comes near, and calls her bone-children up out of the mud. While they live, her lanterns shield her.
bestiary.oathbound.cinder_colossus.name: The Cinder Colossus
bestiary.oathbound.cinder_colossus.note: Bring water or wait for rain: wet, it cracks. Strike the open core. Leaves the *Cinder Heart*, *ember cores* and *gravegold*.
bestiary.oathbound.cinder_colossus.text: A war-effigy of the old sun-cult with a furnace for a heart, still stoking itself in its sunken sanctum under the sands. Its blade cuts lines of fire into the ground and it can make the earth erupt beneath your feet. It opens its chest to vent, and that is when its heart can be struck.
bestiary.oathbound.drowned_choirmonk.not: Its hymn slows you. Break line of sight or strike it mid-song.
bestiary.oathbound.drowned_choirmonk.tex: A monk of the drowned chapel who never stopped singing the vespers. When it sees the living it raises its candle and sings, and the hymn weighs on every limb that hears it.
bestiary.oathbound.duskhare.name: Duskhare
bestiary.oathbound.duskhare.note: Swift and shy. Leaves *rabbit* and *rabbit hide*.
bestiary.oathbound.duskhare.text: A long-eared hare the colour of dusk. Its ear-tips catch the last light, which is usually the only part of it anyone sees.
bestiary.oathbound.elderhorn.name: Elderhorn, the Grove King
bestiary.oathbound.elderhorn.note: Sidestep the charge: if he runs into stone he staggers. Hit him hard while he kneels.
bestiary.oathbound.elderhorn.text: The stag-king of the old groves, crowned with antlers that have grown runes. He sleeps in a ring of standing stones and wakes for anyone who draws steel there. He gores in a straight line, calls roots up out of the ground and bellows a storm of leaves; wounded, he kneels to drink from the grove and must be struck hard to break the trance.
bestiary.oathbound.forsworn_knight.name: Forsworn Knight
bestiary.oathbound.forsworn_knight.note: Only oathsteel, fire or light lays them to rest.
bestiary.oathbound.forsworn_knight.text: Knights of the Order who followed Morvane into the dark. Their oaths are broken, but their armour will not lie still: strike one down and it rises again.
bestiary.oathbound.glimmerfawn.name: Glimmerfawn
bestiary.oathbound.glimmerfawn.note: Creep up on one to see it; it leaves *venison* and, rarely, a glowing *antler*.
bestiary.oathbound.glimmerfawn.text: A slender deer of the old woods whose dapples and antler-tips shine like moonlight. It bolts from anyone who does not creep, and grazes wherever the Lanternguard once walked.
bestiary.oathbound.gloam_stalker.name: Gloam Stalker
bestiary.oathbound.gloam_stalker.note: A lit lantern shows it plainly. Leaves *gloam essence* and, rarely, a *shadow fang*.
bestiary.oathbound.gloam_stalker.text: A long, low cat of the Gloaming. Until it is close it is only a shimmer at the edge of sight; then it is all at once, mid-leap.
bestiary.oathbound.gloamling.name: Gloamling
bestiary.oathbound.gloamling.note: They burn in daylight. Hold a lit lantern to see them clearly.
bestiary.oathbound.gloamling.text: Imps of the dusk that seep out of the Gloaming at night. In darkness they are almost invisible; only a lantern's light holds them to a shape. They strike and scatter, giggling.
bestiary.oathbound.grave_crawler.name: Grave Crawler
bestiary.oathbound.grave_crawler.text: A barrow's leftovers: a skull and a spine on too many arms. They come in knots at night, fast and low, and burn at dawn.
bestiary.oathbound.hrodgar.name: Hrodgar
bestiary.oathbound.hrodgar.note: Jump the shockwaves. At the end, he will try to devour his own guard to heal.
bestiary.oathbound.hrodgar.text: The first Barrow-King, a giant who returned from the grave to give his oath. His flail breaks the earth into rings of force; his housecarls rise to shield him.
bestiary.oathbound.lanternmoth.name: Lanternmoth
bestiary.oathbound.lanternmoth.note: They shed *Luminous Dust*, the heart of lumen flasks and the Elixir of Dawn.
bestiary.oathbound.lanternmoth.text: A gentle moth whose abdomen glows like a lantern-flame. They drift through woodland at night and gather around anyone carrying a light. The Order took them as its heraldic beast.
bestiary.oathbound.lumen_beetle.name: Lumen Beetle
bestiary.oathbound.lumen_beetle.text: A thumb-sized beetle that carries its own lantern through the caves. Miners follow them: they gather where lumenite grows.
bestiary.oathbound.lumenite_mite.name: Lumenite Mite
bestiary.oathbound.lumenite_mite.note: Keep a spare shard for your lantern. Leaves *lumenite dust*.
bestiary.oathbound.lumenite_mite.text: A burrowing mite that eats light. Lumenite grows from its back like a crust of candle-flame, and its bite dims the eyes and drinks a lantern's oil.
bestiary.oathbound.mire_hag.name: Mire Hag
bestiary.oathbound.mire_hag.note: Leaves *gloam essence* and, sometimes, a *hag's eye*.
bestiary.oathbound.mire_hag.text: A swamp witch bent under her lantern, who trades curses for bones. She keeps her distance, flings green fire and, when a blade gets close, is simply somewhere else.
bestiary.oathbound.morvane.name: Morvane
bestiary.oathbound.morvane.note: When the Ward Lanterns go out, light all four again to Unveil him.
bestiary.oathbound.morvane.text: The Hollow King. Once Lord-Commander of the Order; now armour with a void inside it, crowned with a promise that was a lie. He duels, then sorcerers, then hides in the dark.
bestiary.oathbound.mossback_tortoise.not: Its shed *mossback scute* goes into the Elixir of Wards.
bestiary.oathbound.mossback_tortoise.tex: A great slow tortoise with a garden growing on its back. Struck, it draws into its shell and shrugs off most blows; the swamp-folk say they are older than the Order.
bestiary.oathbound.runewisp.name: Runewisp
bestiary.oathbound.runewisp.text: A mote of written light that drifts through birch woods at night. The Arcanists believed they were stray glyphs that escaped their books. It minds its own business; strike it and it answers with runes.
bestiary.oathbound.shade_wraith.name: Shade Wraith
bestiary.oathbound.shade_wraith.note: Strike it as it swoops. Leaves *gloam essence*.
bestiary.oathbound.shade_wraith.text: A hooded shade that drifts over the Gloaming's islands. It circles above its prey, then swoops through it and leaves the cold of the grave behind.
bestiary.oathbound.sir_caldris.name: Sir Caldris
bestiary.oathbound.sir_caldris.note: Flank him, or break his guard with an axe. At half strength he calls drowned squires.
bestiary.oathbound.sir_caldris.text: The Tide-Knight of the Drowned Chapel, still standing his vigil beneath the water. His tower shield turns every frontal blow. His anchor drags the unwary into his reach.
bestiary.oathbound.spectral_housecarl.no: While tethered to Hrodgar, they shield him.
bestiary.oathbound.spectral_housecarl.te: Hrodgar's oath-sworn guards, who would not leave their king even in death. They fight for him still, and for whoever sounds his horn.
bestiary.oathbound.stonewarden.name: Stonewarden
bestiary.oathbound.stonewarden.note: An ally against monsters. Leaves *wardstone* and *lumenite*.
bestiary.oathbound.stonewarden.text: A sentinel of mossy wardstone the Lanternguard left to watch the roads. It still hunts anything of the night that comes near and ignores travellers, unless they strike it first.
bestiary.oathbound.thornback_boar.name: Thornback Boar
bestiary.oathbound.thornback_boar.text: A heavy forest boar with a ridge of black quills. Left alone it roots and grunts; struck, it lowers its tusks and charges, and the whole sounder charges with it.
bestiary.oathbound.tidewader.name: Tidewader
bestiary.oathbound.tidewader.note: Leaves *feathers*; sometimes drops a fresh cod.
bestiary.oathbound.tidewader.text: A tall grey heron of the chapel shallows. It stands so still that fish forget it, then strikes.
bestiary.oathbound.veilhound.name: Veilhound
bestiary.oathbound.veilhound.note: Keep a wall at your back.
bestiary.oathbound.veilhound.text: Pack-hunters of the Gloaming, darker than their own shadows. They circle, testing, and lunge from several sides at once.
block.oathbound.barrow_seal.hint: The seal holds fast. It will open for the honest king.
block.oathbound.sealed_grate.hint: The grate is sealed. Something in this place must open it.

boon.oathbound.long_reach.title: Long Reach
boon.oathbound.oath_of_the_housecarl.des: When you fall low, a Spectral Housecarl rises to guard you. Once every two minutes.

boon.oathbound.scholars_luck.description: +2 Luck: better fishing and better finds.

chronicle.oathbound.lore.0:
You were a squire of the *Order of the Ember Lantern* for one night. Then the Order was gone, and only this book remained, warm in your hands as if someone had just been reading it.

The _Lanternguard_ were knight-wizards who carried the *Everflame*, a fire kindled at the first dawn. For four hundred years they kept the night from coming too far into the world. Their towers are ruins now; their wayshrines are cold.

Begin where they began. Find *lumenite* in the stone, where sunlight fell and stayed. Blend it with iron and forge *Oathsteel*. Build a _Warden's Lantern_ and carry it to a *Wayshrine*. Kindle the brazier. The Order will know you.
chronicle.oathbound.lore.1:
The kindled wayshrine burned for a long time after you left it, and the Chronicle turned its own pages that night.

_Sir Caldris_ was the Order's Tide-Knight, who swore that no tide would ever reach the chapel where the Order kept its vows. The sea came anyway. He is still there, beneath the water-dark nave, keeping the *Seal of Valor* for a war that ended four centuries ago.

The drowned chapel has a *Hymn Stone*. It sings only to a Warden's light. Learn its hymn and ring the chapel bells in that order; the crypt will open. Mind his tower shield: Caldris does not turn his back.
chronicle.oathbound.lore.2:
With the Seal of Valor in your pack the Chronicle wrote in a new hand, thin and precise.

_Archmage Veyl_ taught the Order its wards. When the three bound the Hollow King, Veyl bound his own mind into the *Seal of Wisdom*, so the seal could never forget what it held. He has not forgotten. He has not slept, either.

His spire answers only to those who solve his *Cipher*: four riddles, four glyphs, four dials. The ward before his sanctum will not so much as flicker for anyone who has not first proven their valor. Watch for the one of him whose staff burns gold.
chronicle.oathbound.lore.3:
The Chronicle's pages smell of earth now.

_Hrodgar_ was the first of the Barrow-Kings, dead two hundred years before the Order fell. When the three needed a third oath, he returned from his tomb to give it, and the *Seal of Sacrifice* is sealed with his death as much as his life.

Three other kings sleep in his barrow, and their epitaphs disagree. *Exactly one of them told the truth.* Kneel at the honest king's tomb and Hrodgar's hall will open. Kneel at a liar's, and the barrow will answer.
chronicle.oathbound.lore.4:
Three seals. One key.

The *Oathkey* is the three oaths bound into one: valor, wisdom and sacrifice. The *Sundered Citadel*, where the Order fell in a single night, still holds the gate the three used to shut Morvane out of the world.

Find the citadel. Set the Oathkey into the *Sundered Keystone*. Then step through the veil, into the _Gloaming_: the grey country between dusk and night. Keep your lantern lit there. Those who walk the Gloaming without light begin to fade.
chronicle.oathbound.lore.5:
_Morvane_ was the Lord-Commander of the Order of the Ember Lantern. He feared death more than he loved anything, and in the Gloaming he found the *Hollow Crown*, which promised a reign without end to whoever swore upon it.

He swore, and he lied, and the Gloam poured through him. He is not a man any more. He is armour with a void inside it, sitting a throne on the highest island of the grey country, ringed by four *Ward Lanterns*.

When the lanterns gutter and the dark takes him, light them again. Nothing hides from the Everflame for long.
chronicle.oathbound.lore.6:
Not everything the Order left behind is on the road to the throne.

Lanternguard knights hid their *insignia* in their strongholds, behind brickwork that looks a little too cracked. Their *tablets* still stand in the ruins, each carved with a piece of the Order's history. The creatures of the world have their own stories too.

The Chronicle keeps all of it. Turn its pages when the road is quiet.
chronicle.oathbound.lore.epilogue:
The Hollow Crown cracked, and light came out of it: four hundred years of stolen dawns, all at once.

The Gloaming is still there, between dusk and night, but it is only grey now, not hungry. The veil will open for you whenever you wish. The Everflame is yours to rekindle, if you can gather the insignia of the Order you never got to join.

The Chronicle has one page left, and it is blank. It is waiting for you to write the Order's next oath.
chronicle.oathbound.lore.sealed: These pages are sealed. Walk further along the Path and they will open.

epitaph.oathbound.boast: Of all the kings who sleep in this barrow, I alone never lied.
epitaph.oathbound.vouch: Every word %s ever spoke was true.
item.oathbound.barrow_censer.desc.1: Grave-smoke from the barrow kings' own rites.
item.oathbound.barrow_censer.desc.2: Use: heals you and your companions and hardens their skin.
Cast for the drowned chapel; it still rings with the sea.
Use: a tolling wave hurls back and reveals every foe within 7 blocks.
item.oathbound.boar_tusk.desc.1: Yellowed and sharp. Huntsmen carve horns from them.
Its green flame burns without oil and without warmth.
Use: snuff it to step ten blocks ahead, leaving a cloud of marsh-gas behind.
item.oathbound.cinder_heart.desc.1: The furnace that walked the sands, small enough to hold.
item.oathbound.cinder_heart.desc.2: Use: the ground erupts under every foe around you. Fire cannot touch you for a while.
item.oathbound.cooked_venison.desc.1: Rich and filling; a hunter's supper.
item.oathbound.dawnbreaker.desc.1: Forged to end the Hollow King.
item.oathbound.dawnbreaker.desc.2: Hold use to gather light; release for a Dawn Rite:
item.oathbound.dawnbreaker.desc.3: a burst of sunlight that strikes Gloam creatures and the undead threefold.
item.oathbound.dawnsteel_boots.desc.1: Full set: regeneration and fire resistance under the open sun; immune to Gloamrot.
item.oathbound.dawnsteel_chestplate.desc: Full set: regeneration and fire resistance under the open sun; immune to Gloamrot.
item.oathbound.dawnsteel_greatsword.desc: Quenched in the Everflame, it is warm to the touch and never dims.
Burns the Gloam and the undead for half again as much, and sets them alight.
item.oathbound.dawnsteel_helmet.desc.1: Full set: regeneration and fire resistance under the open sun; immune to Gloamrot.
item.oathbound.dawnsteel_leggings.desc.1: Full set: regeneration and fire resistance under the open sun; immune to Gloamrot.
item.oathbound.dawnstring_longbow.desc.1: Strung with light, and it remembers it.
item.oathbound.dawnstring_longbow.desc.2: Fully drawn: the arrow burns with dawn and pierces.
item.oathbound.dawnstring_longbow.desc.3: Targets struck are Sunmarked: they glow and take 30% more damage.
item.oathbound.drowned_anchor.desc.1: It still drips, a long way from any sea.
item.oathbound.drowned_anchor.desc.2: Use to throw it on its chain:
item.oathbound.drowned_anchor.desc.3: hooks a creature and hauls it to you, or hauls you to the stone it bites.
item.oathbound.duskiron_boots.desc.1: Full set: swift and strong in darkness; clear sight in the Gloaming.
Full set: swift and strong in darkness; clear sight in the Gloaming.
item.oathbound.duskiron_glaive.desc.1: Forged of the Gloaming's iron; it drinks the light around it.
item.oathbound.duskiron_glaive.desc.2: Long reach. Deals 30% more damage in darkness.
item.oathbound.duskiron_helmet.desc.1: Full set: swift and strong in darkness; clear sight in the Gloaming.
item.oathbound.duskiron_ingot.desc.1: Iron that drinks the light around it.
item.oathbound.duskiron_leggings.desc.1: Full set: swift and strong in darkness; clear sight in the Gloaming.
item.oathbound.elixir_of_dawn.desc.1: Drink the morning. Cures Gloamrot and grants Radiance for three minutes.
item.oathbound.elixir_of_shrouds.desc.1: See in the dark, and be the dark.
item.oathbound.elixir_of_tides.desc.1: Breathe the sea and swim it like a seal.
item.oathbound.elixir_of_valor.desc.1: Sir Caldris' squires drank it before battle.
item.oathbound.ember_core.desc.1: The heart of a revenant, still burning after four hundred years.
item.oathbound.emberroot_stew.desc.1: Hot enough that fire seems mild after it.
item.oathbound.everflame_ember.desc.1: A coal of the first dawn, won back from the Hollow King.
item.oathbound.everflame_ember.desc.2: Warm enough to kindle the Everflame Lantern.
item.oathbound.everflame_lantern.desc.3: Seeks, lights and wards like a Warden's Lantern.
item.oathbound.glimmer_antler.desc.1: The tip still holds a little moonlight. Grind it into luminous dust.
item.oathbound.gloam_essence.desc.1: A little of the grey country, cold to the touch.
item.oathbound.gravegold_blend.desc.1: Gold, bone and a breath of the Gloam, ready for the furnace.
item.oathbound.gravegold_boots.desc.1: Full set: the undead hurt you 30% less, and you strike them harder.
item.oathbound.gravegold_chestplate.desc: Full set: the undead hurt you 30% less, and you strike them harder.
item.oathbound.gravegold_helmet.desc.1: Full set: the undead hurt you 30% less, and you strike them harder.
item.oathbound.gravegold_ingot.desc.1: Gold from the barrows. It is cold even in the sun.
item.oathbound.gravegold_khopesh.desc.1: The barrow kings were buried with these, and did not rest easy.
item.oathbound.gravegold_khopesh.desc.2: Deals 60% more damage to the undead.
item.oathbound.gravegold_leggings.desc.1: Full set: the undead hurt you 30% less, and you strike them harder.
item.oathbound.grove_kings_crown.desc.1: A tine of the Elderhorn's antlers, still putting out leaves.
item.oathbound.grove_kings_crown.desc.2: Use: roots burst up under every foe near you, and the grove mends you.
item.oathbound.hag_eye.desc.1: It is not a real eye. It still blinks.
item.oathbound.heart_of_the_gloam.desc.1: A shard of dusk that beats slowly in the hand.
item.oathbound.heart_of_the_gloam.desc.2: Use: the dusk wraps you; whatever hunted you forgets you.
item.oathbound.hearth_pie.desc.1: A pie of meat and egg under a thick crust, as the barracks cooks made it.
item.oathbound.hollow_crown.desc.1: Morvane swore on it. Nothing wears it now.
item.oathbound.hollow_crown.desc.2: Night vision. Gloam creatures leave you be unless struck.
item.oathbound.honeycake.desc.1: Soft, sweet and still warm from somewhere.
item.oathbound.honeyed_mead.desc.1: The Order's own. Regeneration and a golden warmth; mind the spinning.
item.oathbound.housecarl_warhorn.desc.2: Sound it to call two Spectral Housecarls to fight beside you for 40s.
item.oathbound.huntsmans_horn.desc.1: The wayshrine wardens' horn, for calling out what hides.
item.oathbound.huntsmans_horn.desc.2: Use: every foe within 32 blocks is outlined in light.
item.oathbound.knights_stew.desc.1: A meal to march on: Resistance and Strength.
item.oathbound.lantern_chronicle.desc.1: The living book of the Lanternguard. It chose you.
item.oathbound.lantern_chronicle.desc.2: Use to open. It remembers what you do.
item.oathbound.lanternguard_insignia.des: A knight's badge: a lantern on a shield.
Four of these and an Everflame Ember remake the Order's lantern.
Worn by the Order's captains. It is warm when it is needed.
Use: strength and swiftness for everyone near you.
item.oathbound.lumen_flask.desc.2: Throw to burst in blinding light that burns Gloam creatures and leaves wisplights.
item.oathbound.lumenite_dust.desc.1: It glitters even in a closed fist.
item.oathbound.lumenite_shard.desc.1: Sunlight that fell into the stone and stayed.
item.oathbound.lumenite_shard.desc.2: Use with a Warden's Lantern in the other hand to refuel it.
item.oathbound.luminous_dust.desc.1: Shed by lanternmoths. It never quite stops glowing.
item.oathbound.moonpetal_tea.desc.1: Pale and fragrant; the night seems kinder after a cup.
item.oathbound.mossback_scute.desc.1: A shed plate of tortoise shell, green with moss. It turns blows aside.
item.oathbound.oathkey.desc.1: Three oaths bound into one key.
item.oathbound.oathkey.desc.2: Use on the Sundered Keystone to open the Gate.
item.oathbound.oathsteel_blend.desc.1: Iron and lumenite, waiting for the fire.
A knight's blade: patient, then sudden.
Riposte: damage you take in the last 3s is added to your next blow.
item.oathbound.raw_duskiron.desc.1: Dark iron from the Gloaming. Smelt it.
item.oathbound.raw_venison.desc.1: Lean meat from a glimmerfawn. Better cooked.
item.oathbound.runesilver_blend.desc.1: Iron ground with lapis and light, ready for the furnace.
item.oathbound.runesilver_boots.desc.1: Full set: spells and magic hurt you 40% less.
item.oathbound.runesilver_chestplate.des: Full set: spells and magic hurt you 40% less.
item.oathbound.runesilver_helmet.desc.1: Full set: spells and magic hurt you 40% less.
item.oathbound.runesilver_ingot.desc.1: Silver that hums with written light.
Full set: spells and magic hurt you 40% less.
item.oathbound.runesilver_rapier.desc.1: Its fuller is a line of runes that wake when it moves.
item.oathbound.runesilver_rapier.desc.2: Every thrust carries a glyph: +4 magic damage. Reaches a little further.
item.oathbound.seal_of_sacrifice.desc.1: Given up by Hrodgar, the Barrow-King.
item.oathbound.seal_of_sacrifice.desc.2: One of the three seals of the Oathkey.
item.oathbound.seal_of_valor.desc.1: Given up by Sir Caldris of the Drowned Chapel.
item.oathbound.seal_of_valor.desc.2: One of the three seals of the Oathkey.
item.oathbound.seal_of_wisdom.desc.1: Given up by Archmage Veyl of the Hollow Spire.
item.oathbound.seal_of_wisdom.desc.2: One of the three seals of the Oathkey.
item.oathbound.shadow_fang.desc.1: A stalker's fang, cold and hard to see even in the hand.
item.oathbound.shadowreap_sickle.desc.2: The darker the place, the harder it strikes and the more it heals you.
item.oathbound.spellsilk.desc.1: Woven on looms that were never touched by hands.
item.oathbound.spiced_cider.desc.1: Apples and emberroot. It puts a spring in any work.
item.oathbound.staff_of_veyl.desc.1: The Archmage never set it down.
item.oathbound.staff_of_veyl.desc.2: Use to loose an Arcane Chain that leaps between up to five foes,
item.oathbound.sunshard_talisman.desc.1: A splinter of the first dawn, freed when the Hollow Crown broke.
item.oathbound.sunshard_talisman.desc.2: Use: a flash of dawn burns the Gloam and the dead.
item.oathbound.tidebronze_blend.desc.1: Copper, sea-glass and lumenite, ready for the furnace.
item.oathbound.tidebronze_boots.desc.1: Full set: conduit power and dolphin's grace while in water.
item.oathbound.tidebronze_chestplate.des: Full set: conduit power and dolphin's grace while in water.
item.oathbound.tidebronze_gladius.desc.1: A short sea-blade, green at the edges where the salt has kissed it.
item.oathbound.tidebronze_gladius.desc.2: Strikes half again as hard while you stand in water or rain.
item.oathbound.tidebronze_helmet.desc.1: Full set: conduit power and dolphin's grace while in water.
Full set: conduit power and dolphin's grace while in water.
item.oathbound.trail_rations.desc.1: Dried meat, hard bread and an apple, wrapped in waxed cloth. Quick to eat.
item.oathbound.veyls_mirror.desc.1: The Archmage looked into it until it looked back.
item.oathbound.veyls_mirror.desc.2: Use: step through the glass up to 8 blocks ahead.
item.oathbound.wardens_halberd.desc.2: +1.5 reach. A sprinting strike thrusts through a whole line of foes.
item.oathbound.wardens_lantern.desc.1: The Lanternguard never walked in the dark.
item.oathbound.wardens_lantern.desc.2: Held: a wisplight follows you; lights Hymn Stones and Ward Lanterns.
item.oathbound.wardens_lantern.desc.3: Use to Seek where the Chronicle would have you go. Burns lumenite.
lore.oathbound.bog_mother.1: She will cure anything, the swamp-folk say, for the right bones. She has never said whose.
lore.oathbound.bog_mother.2: Every hag in the mire is one of her daughters, and every one of them has her lanterns.
lore.oathbound.bog_mother.title: The Bog Mother's Bargain
lore.oathbound.drowned_choir.1: When the chapel went under, the choir went down still singing. Their hymn is in the grotto now,
lore.oathbound.drowned_choir.2: echoing off the crystal. Sailors who hear it at low tide say it is almost beautiful.
lore.oathbound.drowned_choir.title: The Drowned Choir
lore.oathbound.everflame.1: The Everflame is not hot. It is only certain. Steel quenched in it remembers dawn
lore.oathbound.everflame.2: for as long as it lasts; the Order called that steel Dawnsteel, and made very little of it.
lore.oathbound.everflame.title: On the Everflame
lore.oathbound.first_lantern.1: Before the Order there was only the Lantern: a fire someone carried out of the first dawn,
lore.oathbound.first_lantern.2: and refused to let go out. The first knights were only the people who took turns carrying it.
lore.oathbound.first_lantern.title: The First Lantern
lore.oathbound.four_riddles.1: Veyl hid the Seal of Wisdom behind riddles he answered himself, every morning, for a century.
lore.oathbound.four_riddles.2: His apprentices said he did it to remember. Veyl said he did it so he would not.
lore.oathbound.four_riddles.title: On the Four Riddles
lore.oathbound.grove_king.1: The rangers left the old ring alone. Something in it had been king there before the Order,
lore.oathbound.grove_king.2: and would be king after. They left it salt and apples at midsummer, and walked round.
lore.oathbound.grove_king.title: The Stag in the Ring
lore.oathbound.hollow_crown.1: It promised a reign without end to whoever swore on it. It did not say what would reign.
lore.oathbound.hollow_crown.2: Morvane swore. The crown kept its word. What sits the throne now is the crown's, not his.
lore.oathbound.hollow_crown.title: The Hollow Crown
lore.oathbound.honest_king.1: Three kings sleep beside Hrodgar, and each wrote an epitaph about the others.
lore.oathbound.honest_king.2: Only one of them never lied. The barrow opens for whoever can tell which.
lore.oathbound.honest_king.title: Of the Honest King
lore.oathbound.last_squire.1: If you are reading this, the Lantern has chosen again. It has never chosen wrong.
lore.oathbound.last_squire.2: Carry it. It will be heavy. It is supposed to be.
lore.oathbound.last_squire.title: To Whoever Finds This
lore.oathbound.last_watch.1: Light the signal if the dead walk. Light it if the sea rises. Light it if you are afraid.
lore.oathbound.last_watch.2: The tower is empty now, but the fire is always laid. The stone warden sees to that.
lore.oathbound.last_watch.title: The Last Watch
lore.oathbound.lord_commander.1: Morvane was the best of us. He led the Order for forty years and lost no one he could have saved.
lore.oathbound.lord_commander.2: He could not save himself from growing old, and that was the thing he could not forgive.
lore.oathbound.lord_commander.title: The Lord-Commander
lore.oathbound.lumenite_rush.1: For a summer everyone dug for lumenite. Then the mites came up out of the deep veins, eating
lore.oathbound.lumenite_rush.2: the light from the lamps, and the miners came up out of the shafts in the dark.
lore.oathbound.lumenite_rush.title: The Lumenite Rush
lore.oathbound.oath_of_ember.1: "I will keep the light when I cannot see it. I will keep it when it burns my hands.
lore.oathbound.oath_of_ember.2: I will keep it until someone is there to take it from me." Every squire said it once, at dawn.
lore.oathbound.oath_of_ember.title: The Oath of the Ember
lore.oathbound.star_readers.1: They watched the sky for the Gloam's coming, and they saw it: every star going out, one by one,
lore.oathbound.star_readers.2: like lamps down a long street. The last entry in their chart is only a date.
lore.oathbound.star_readers.title: The Star-Readers
lore.oathbound.sun_cult.1: Before the Lanternguard carried the first dawn, the desert-folk worshipped the noon.
lore.oathbound.sun_cult.2: They built a furnace that could walk, to carry their sun to war. It is still carrying it.
lore.oathbound.sun_cult.title: Of the Sun-Cult
lore.oathbound.sundering.1: The citadel fell in one night. The Lanterns went out one by one, from the gate inward.
lore.oathbound.sundering.2: By dawn three keepers had shut the Gloam out, and the Order was gone.
lore.oathbound.sundering.title: The Night of Sundering
lore.oathbound.the_gloaming.1: Between dusk and night there is a country. It is always just about to be dark there.
lore.oathbound.the_gloaming.2: Things that are almost gone go there: echoes, lost oaths, and people who will not die.
lore.oathbound.the_gloaming.title: Of the Grey Country
lore.oathbound.three_seals.1: Valor, wisdom and sacrifice: three oaths bound three keepers to three seals,
lore.oathbound.three_seals.2: and the seals bound the gate. Break none of them, and the Hollow King sleeps forever.
lore.oathbound.three_seals.title: The Three Seals
lore.oathbound.tide_knight.1: Caldris swore no tide would reach the chapel. When the sea rose he did not leave;
lore.oathbound.tide_knight.2: he held the doors shut from the inside. The chapel bells still ring on the ebb.
lore.oathbound.tide_knight.title: The Tide-Knight's Vow
message.oathbound.bog_mother.brood: Her bone-children shield the Bog Mother. Kill the brood!
message.oathbound.cinder_colossus.molten: The Colossus runs molten. Its every step scorches.
message.oathbound.cipher.dark: The pages are blank. The cipher reveals itself only to one who holds the Seal of Valor.
message.oathbound.cipher.instructions: Set each numbered Rune Dial to the glyph its riddle names.
message.oathbound.cipher.opened: The cipher is solved. The sanctum stands open.
message.oathbound.cipher.solved: The dials lock. The ward before the sanctum shivers and dissolves.
message.oathbound.cipher.title: ~ The Archmage's Cipher ~
message.oathbound.dial.locked: The dial will not move. The cipher is solved.
message.oathbound.dial.valor: The dial is frozen fast. Only one who holds the Seal of Valor may turn it.
message.oathbound.elderhorn.bloom: The Grove King kneels to drink from the grove. Strike hard to break the trance!
message.oathbound.forsworn.rest: The knight's armour falls still. At last.
message.oathbound.gate.begin: You set the Oathkey into the keystone. The three oaths wake...
message.oathbound.gate.hint: A keystone with three empty settings. The Oathkey would fit it.
message.oathbound.gate.open_hint: The Gate is open. The veil hangs in the arch.
message.oathbound.gloaming.missing: The veil will not open: the Gloaming is missing from this world. (Is the mod's data pack disabled?)
message.oathbound.gloamrot: Without light, the Gloaming begins to take the colour out of you.
message.oathbound.hrodgar.tethered: Hrodgar's housecarls shield him. Break their tethers!
message.oathbound.hymn.cold: The stone is cold and silent. It answers only a Warden's light.
message.oathbound.hymn.cold_short: The bells are silent without a Warden's light.
message.oathbound.hymn.discord: The bells clash. Something stirs in the flooded nave.
message.oathbound.hymn.instructions: Ring the chapel bells in this order. A wrong note starts the hymn over.
message.oathbound.hymn.opened: The last bell fades... and far below, the crypt grate lifts.
message.oathbound.hymn.title: ~ The Hymn of the Tide ~
message.oathbound.hymn.verse: Five bells for the five waves that took the chapel. Ring them as the stone sings them.
message.oathbound.lantern.empty: Your lantern has burned out. Feed it a lumenite shard.
message.oathbound.lantern.out: Your lantern gutters and goes dark.
message.oathbound.morvane.hollow: The lanterns are out. Morvane cannot be touched in the dark.
message.oathbound.morvane.phase2: "You carry his lantern. I carried it too." Morvane rises from the ground on wings of dusk.
message.oathbound.morvane.phase3: The Ward Lanterns go out. The Hollow King becomes the dark itself. Light them!
message.oathbound.morvane.unveiled: All four lanterns blaze! Morvane is UNVEILED.
message.oathbound.morvane.wake: The lanterns gutter, one by one. On the throne, something that was a man lifts its head.
message.oathbound.relic.no_room: There is no room to step there
message.oathbound.seek.far: The lantern strains toward %s, but it is too far to see.
message.oathbound.seek.none: The lantern has nowhere left to lead you. Your road is your own.
message.oathbound.shard.no_lantern: Hold a Warden's Lantern in your other hand to refuel it.
message.oathbound.tomb.honest: %s told the truth. His tomb grinds open, and the way to Hrodgar's hall is clear.
message.oathbound.tomb.kneel_hint: (Sneak and use the tomb to kneel before this king.)
message.oathbound.tomb.liar: %s lied, even in death. His barrow wakes!
message.oathbound.tomb.wisdom: You kneel, but the tomb does not know you. Return with the Seal of Wisdom.
message.oathbound.ward.hint: An arcane ward. Somewhere in this place is the answer that dissolves it.
message.oathbound.ward_lantern.hint: Light it with a lit Warden's Lantern or a lumenite shard.
message.oathbound.wayshrine.blessing: The shrine's warmth settles on you.
message.oathbound.wayshrine.hint: Kindle the brazier with a lit Warden's Lantern in your hand.
message.oathbound.wayshrine.kindled: The wayshrine takes the flame. Somewhere, the Order remembers.
message.oathbound.wayshrine.no_tithes: The Order owes you nothing yet.
message.oathbound.welcome: The Lantern Chronicle has chosen you. Open it to begin.
quest.oathbound.anchor.title: Something to Hold On To
quest.oathbound.arcanist.description: Sew any piece of Arcanist regalia.
quest.oathbound.arcanist.hint: The full set halves the cooldowns of the Order's arts.
quest.oathbound.arcanist.title: Regalia of the Spire
quest.oathbound.barrow.description: Find the Barrow of Kings, a green mound on the open plains.
quest.oathbound.barrow.title: The Barrow of Kings
quest.oathbound.bog_mother.description: Find the stilt-house in the swamp and put out the Bog Mother's lanterns.
quest.oathbound.bog_mother.hint: Swamps. Kill her bone-children first: while they live, her lanterns shield her.
quest.oathbound.bog_mother.title: The Mother of Hags
quest.oathbound.caldris.description: Defeat Sir Caldris and take back the Seal of Valor.
quest.oathbound.caldris.hint: His shield blocks everything from the front. Flank him, or break his guard with an axe.
quest.oathbound.caldris.title: The Drowned Knight
quest.oathbound.chapel.description: Find a Drowned Chapel at the edge of a swamp, river or shore.
quest.oathbound.chapel.hint: Your lantern's Seek will point the way once the wayshrine is kindled.
quest.oathbound.chapel.title: Where the Bells Drown
quest.oathbound.cinder_colossus.descript: Go down into the sun-cult's sanctum and quench the Cinder Colossus.
quest.oathbound.cinder_colossus.hint: A stepped pyramid in the desert or the badlands. Water cracks it; its open core takes double harm.
quest.oathbound.cinder_colossus.title: The Walking Furnace
quest.oathbound.cipher.description: Solve Veyl's four riddles and set the four Rune Dials to match.
quest.oathbound.cipher.hint: Read the Cipher on its lectern. Dial I answers riddle I, and so on.
quest.oathbound.cipher.title: The Archmage's Cipher
quest.oathbound.citadel.description: Find the ruin where the Order fell.
quest.oathbound.citadel.hint: It is rare, and far. Seek with your lantern.
quest.oathbound.citadel.title: The Sundered Citadel
quest.oathbound.crown.hint: It will not hurt you. You never swore on it.
quest.oathbound.crown.title: Uneasy Lies the Head
quest.oathbound.dawnbreaker.title: The First Light, Forged
quest.oathbound.dawnstring.title: Strung with Light
quest.oathbound.delve.description: Climb down an abandoned lumenite mine.
quest.oathbound.delve.hint: Look for a timber headframe over a shaft in the forests and hills. Take spare lumenite: the mites drink lantern oil.
quest.oathbound.delve.title: The Lumenite Delve
quest.oathbound.elixir.hint: A bottle, luminous dust, gloam essence and a golden carrot.
quest.oathbound.elixir.title: Drink the Morning
quest.oathbound.everflame.hint: Four insignia around a Warden's Lantern, with Everflame Embers.
quest.oathbound.everflame.title: The Everflame Rekindled
quest.oathbound.flask.title: Light, Corked
quest.oathbound.forsworn.description: Lay a Forsworn Knight to rest for good.
quest.oathbound.forsworn.hint: They rise again unless the last blow is oathsteel, fire or light.
quest.oathbound.forsworn.title: Rest for the Forsworn
quest.oathbound.gate.description: Set the Oathkey in the Sundered Keystone and open the Gate.
quest.oathbound.gate.hint: Use the Oathkey on the keystone at the heart of the citadel.
quest.oathbound.gate.title: Open the Sundered Gate
quest.oathbound.gloaming.description: Step through the veil into the grey country.
quest.oathbound.gloaming.hint: Keep a lantern lit, or drink an Elixir of Dawn.
quest.oathbound.gloaming.title: Into the Gloaming
quest.oathbound.gloamling.hint: Hold a lit lantern: they cannot hide in its light.
quest.oathbound.gloamling.title: Things that Giggle in the Dark
quest.oathbound.grove_king.description: Wake the Elderhorn in his ring of stones, and fell him.
quest.oathbound.grove_king.hint: A ring of runestones in the flowering woods. Sidestep his charge; strike hard while he kneels.
quest.oathbound.grove_king.title: The Grove King
quest.oathbound.honest_king.description: Read the three epitaphs and kneel at the tomb of the only king who told the truth.
quest.oathbound.honest_king.hint: Exactly one epitaph is true. Sneak and use the tomb to kneel. You must carry the Seal of Wisdom.
quest.oathbound.honest_king.title: One of Three Told the Truth
quest.oathbound.hrodgar.description: Defeat Hrodgar and take back the Seal of Sacrifice.
quest.oathbound.hrodgar.hint: Jump his flail's shockwaves. Break the tethers of his housecarls before you strike at him.
quest.oathbound.hrodgar.title: The Barrow-King
quest.oathbound.hymn.description: Learn the Hymn Stone's song by lantern-light, then ring the chapel bells in its order.
quest.oathbound.hymn.hint: Read the Hymn Stone with a lit lantern. A wrong note starts the hymn over.
quest.oathbound.hymn.title: The Hymn of the Tide
quest.oathbound.insignia.hint: Every stronghold hides one behind cracked brickwork.
quest.oathbound.insignia.title: A Knight's Badge
quest.oathbound.lantern.description: Craft the lantern every knight of the Order carried.
quest.oathbound.lantern.hint: Nuggets around a lumenite shard, on an oathsteel ingot.
quest.oathbound.lantern.title: The Warden's Lantern
quest.oathbound.lanternmoth.hint: They drift through woods at night, drawn to your light.
quest.oathbound.lanternmoth.title: Moths to a Lantern
quest.oathbound.last_watch.hint: They stand on windy heights: hills, meadows and plains. A stonewarden keeps the door.
quest.oathbound.last_watch.title: The Last Watch
quest.oathbound.loremaster.hint: They stand in the Order's ruins, one or two in each.
quest.oathbound.loremaster.title: Keeper of the Chronicle
quest.oathbound.lumenite.description: Mine Lumenite Ore, which glows faintly in the deep rock.
quest.oathbound.lumenite.hint: Lumenite is found from deep below up to about y 56. An iron pickaxe or better.
quest.oathbound.lumenite.title: Sunlight in Stone
quest.oathbound.morvane.description: Break the Hollow Crown. Defeat Morvane.
quest.oathbound.morvane.hint: When the lanterns go out, light them again. All four lit leaves him Unveiled.
quest.oathbound.morvane.title: The Hollow King
quest.oathbound.oathkey.description: Bind the three seals into the Oathkey.
quest.oathbound.oathkey.hint: The three seals around an oathsteel ingot, over gold.
quest.oathbound.oathkey.title: Three Oaths, One Key
quest.oathbound.oathsteel.description: Blend iron with lumenite and smelt the blend into an Oathsteel Ingot.
quest.oathbound.oathsteel.hint: Oathsteel Blend: 1 iron ingot + 2 lumenite shards, shapeless. Smelt it.
quest.oathbound.oathsteel.title: Forge Oathsteel
quest.oathbound.oathsteel_armor.descript: Forge any piece of Oathsteel armour.
quest.oathbound.oathsteel_armor.title: The Knight's Harness
quest.oathbound.oathsteel_arms.descripti: Forge an Oathsteel Longsword or a Warden's Halberd.
quest.oathbound.oathsteel_arms.hint: Both are made from oathsteel and sticks.
quest.oathbound.oathsteel_arms.title: Oath-Forged Arms
quest.oathbound.root.description: Open the Chronicle. Its pages will fill as you walk the Order's road.
quest.oathbound.root.hint: Right-click the Chronicle to open it.
quest.oathbound.root.title: The Lantern Chronicle
quest.oathbound.sickle.hint: Oathsteel, gloam essence and a stick.
quest.oathbound.sickle.title: It Drinks the Dark
quest.oathbound.spellsilk.hint: Animated Tomes shed it; the spire's shelves hold more.
quest.oathbound.spellsilk.title: Woven Without Hands
quest.oathbound.spire.description: Find the Arcanist's Spire in the forests or the northern woods.
quest.oathbound.spire.title: The Hollow Spire
quest.oathbound.star_readers.description: Find the star-readers' shattered observatory in the Gloaming.
quest.oathbound.star_readers.hint: A broken glass dome on a Gloaming island. Shade wraiths nest in its gallery.
quest.oathbound.star_readers.title: Where the Stars Went Out
quest.oathbound.throne.description: Climb to the Hollow Throne and challenge the King.
quest.oathbound.throne.hint: The throne stands on the Gloaming's high island.
quest.oathbound.throne.title: The Hollow Throne
quest.oathbound.tideglass.description: Find the drowned choir's grotto by the sea.
quest.oathbound.tideglass.hint: Beaches and stony shores. Listen for singing at the waterline.
quest.oathbound.tideglass.title: Crystal Under the Rocks
quest.oathbound.veilhound.hint: They circle before they strike. Keep your back to something.
quest.oathbound.veilhound.title: The Hounds of the Veil
quest.oathbound.veyl.description: Defeat Archmage Veyl and take back the Seal of Wisdom.
quest.oathbound.veyl.hint: Strike his orbs back at him. Of his mirror images, the real Veyl's staff burns gold.
quest.oathbound.veyl.title: The Hollow Magus
quest.oathbound.warhorn.title: The Housecarls' Call
quest.oathbound.wayshrine.description: Find one of the Order's roadside wayshrines and kindle its brazier with your lantern.
quest.oathbound.wayshrine.hint: Use the lantern to Seek. Kindle the brazier with the lantern lit in your hand.
quest.oathbound.wayshrine.title: Kindle a Wayshrine
riddle.oathbound.0.0: I am carried into the dark so that the dark may be carried out.
riddle.oathbound.0.1: I have a heart of fire and a body of iron, and I hang from a hand.
riddle.oathbound.1.0: Two roads meet in me, and neither ends.
riddle.oathbound.1.1: I am where the sword and the oath cross.
riddle.oathbound.2.0: Break me, and what I held is free.
riddle.oathbound.2.1: I am pressed in wax and in stone, and I keep what I close.
riddle.oathbound.3.0: I have walls but no rooms, and I am the last to fall.
riddle.oathbound.3.1: Four towers, one heart; the siege ends when I do.
riddle.oathbound.4.0: I see only what is lit, and I am the first thing a ward must fool.
riddle.oathbound.4.1: I open at dawn and close at dusk, and I weep.
riddle.oathbound.5.0: I sat on the head of a man who lied, and I was empty.
riddle.oathbound.5.1: I have points but no edge, and a king under me.
tablet.oathbound.0.1: Before the first morning there was only the grey,
tablet.oathbound.0.2: and in the grey a single ember that would not go out.
tablet.oathbound.0.3: The first knights carried it out into the world
tablet.oathbound.0.title: The First Dawn
tablet.oathbound.1.1: We swear to carry light where it is needed,
tablet.oathbound.1.2: to walk first into the dark,
tablet.oathbound.1.3: to keep no flame for ourselves alone.
tablet.oathbound.1.4: So swore every squire. So swore Morvane.
tablet.oathbound.1.title: The Order of the Ember Lantern
tablet.oathbound.2.1: Where the road is long, kindle a shrine.
tablet.oathbound.2.2: Where a shrine is kindled, the Order is fed.
tablet.oathbound.2.3: A cold shrine is a knight who did not come home.
tablet.oathbound.2.title: On Wayshrines
tablet.oathbound.3.1: Caldris swore the tide would not take the chapel.
tablet.oathbound.3.3: He stood in the nave until the water closed over his helm,
tablet.oathbound.3.4: and he is standing there still.
tablet.oathbound.3.5: Some oaths are kept past all reason.
tablet.oathbound.3.title: The Tide-Knight
tablet.oathbound.4.1: A ward is a question the dark cannot answer.
tablet.oathbound.4.2: Ask it well, and ask it forever.
tablet.oathbound.4.3: I have bound my own mind into this seal
tablet.oathbound.4.4: so that the question will never be forgotten.
tablet.oathbound.4.title: The Archmage's Maxim
tablet.oathbound.5.1: Hrodgar was two hundred years dead when we called him.
tablet.oathbound.5.2: He came, and he gave his oath,
tablet.oathbound.5.3: and he lay down again under the green mound.
tablet.oathbound.5.4: His housecarls would not leave him.
tablet.oathbound.5.5: They are there yet, and so is he.
tablet.oathbound.5.title: The Barrow-King
tablet.oathbound.6.1: The Lord-Commander came back from the Gloaming wearing a crown.
tablet.oathbound.6.2: By midnight the lanterns were out.
tablet.oathbound.6.3: By dawn there was no Order left to raise them.
tablet.oathbound.6.4: Only three of us still had our oaths.
tablet.oathbound.6.title: The Night of Ash
tablet.oathbound.7.3: Sacrifice to pay for the lock.
tablet.oathbound.7.4: Three seals, one key, and a gate that must never open
tablet.oathbound.7.5: unless the Order returns to close it for good.
tablet.oathbound.7.title: The Binding
tablet.oathbound.8.1: Between dusk and night there is a country
tablet.oathbound.8.2: where nothing is born and nothing quite dies.
tablet.oathbound.8.3: Carry light there, or it will take the colour out of you
tablet.oathbound.8.title: The Grey Country
tablet.oathbound.9.1: If you are reading this, the Chronicle has chosen.
tablet.oathbound.9.2: We are sorry to leave you so much work.
tablet.oathbound.9.3: Kindle the shrines. Keep the oaths.
tablet.oathbound.9.title: To the Last Squire
title.oathbound.bog_mother.slain.sub: The Bog Mother sinks into the mire
title.oathbound.caldris.slain.sub: Sir Caldris lays down his vigil at last
title.oathbound.cinder_colossus.slain.su: The sun-cult's engine is still at last
title.oathbound.gate.sub: The veil to the Gloaming hangs in the arch
